verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions linking Sentry issues to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, and never mentions two-way status sync where resolving the ticket resolves the error or a regression reopens it. The closest items do not qualify: the pricing line 'API & third-party integrations' is generic, the 'Issue Status' page appears only as a title, and the Slack and PagerDuty entries are adjacent notification integrations. Issue-tracker sync is a fair axis for an error-monitoring platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.
